messages:
Helena (Billing): Spot check of today's batch showed some invoices where the reserved_capacity credit is absent and VAT appears twice on the same invoice. A few invoices ended up with negative totals.
Owen (Eng): job id?
Helena (Billing): invoice-run-2026-05-13-03. Log excerpt:
```
lines:
  - usage_compute: 300.00
  - # missing reserved_capacity_credit: -150.00
  - vat: 0.00
  - vat: 30.00
```
Helena (Billing): Looks like credit application is async; tax-service sometimes runs on gross and again on net path, duplicating VAT lines.
billing-bot: invoice-run-2026-05-13-03 finished with 14 warnings, 3 errors (TAX_DUPLICATE, MISSING_RESERVED_LINE, EXPORT_BLOCKED_NEG_TOTAL).
Priya (Payments): If Stripe sees negative totals it'll reject and create drafts we have to reconcile. I recommend pausing export for that run.
Owen (Eng): I'll push a short-term exporter guard to block negative-final invoices and dedupe tax lines by tax_code (case-insensitive). Will also add an assertion that total == sum(lines) + sum(taxes).
Marco (RevOps): Need a CSV of affected invoice_ids and account owners for sales outreach. Also prepare credit memo playbook if customers were overbilled.
Helena (Billing): I'll compile the list. Preliminary: 13 EU customers affected, 2 enterprise accounts. Target: notify customers within 24h and remediate in 48h.
Owen (Eng): Root cause likely the race between apply_credits and calculate_taxes. Long-term fix: single tax computation on finalized line items. Short-term: dedupe, guard, and add tests.
Priya (Payments): After fix, we'll re-export only impacted invoices using idempotent keys and manual review for any drafts Stripe created.
Helena (Billing): Holding exports now. I'll post the customer notification draft in ~2 hours. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
